blueprint_concepts: Distance of a point from a line, distance between parallel lines

concept_use.Parametric form of a line: The parametric form P = (2 + r cos theta, 3 + r sin theta) with r = AP describes the points of the ray.
concept_use.Distance of a point from a line, distanc: The distance of P from the line M, |12x - 5y + 55|/13, is set equal to r.

english: Let $M$ be the line $12x-5y+55=0$, and let $A=(2,3)$. A ray starts at $A$ and makes an angle $\theta$ with the positive direction of the $x$-axis, where $\tan\theta=\dfrac34$ and $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$. A point $P$ on this ray, different from $A$, is at equal distances from $A$ and from the line $M$. Then the value of $AP$ is ______.
hindi: माना $M$ रेखा $12x-5y+55=0$ है, तथा $A=(2,3)$ है। एक किरण $A$ से प्रारम्भ होकर धनात्मक $x$-अक्ष की दिशा से कोण $\theta$ बनाती है, जहाँ $\tan\theta=\dfrac34$ तथा $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ है। इस किरण पर एक बिन्दु $P$, जो $A$ से भिन्न है, $A$ से तथा रेखा $M$ से समान दूरी पर है। तब $AP$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: With $\tan\theta=\frac34$ and $\theta$ acute, $\cos\theta=\frac45$ and $\sin\theta=\frac35$. The parametric form of the ray gives every point as $P=(2+r\cos\theta,\,3+r\sin\theta)=\left(2+\frac{4r}{5},\,3+\frac{3r}{5}\right)$ with $r=AP>0$.
For $r>0$ the expression inside is positive, so the condition is $\dfrac{64+\frac{33r}{5}}{13}=r$.
originality_note: New: a point on a ray in parametric form is fixed by being equidistant from the starting point and a line, so the distance formula becomes a linear equation in the parameter r with the sign settled by r > 0 (way 5). Closest known: 'points on a line at distance r from a given point (parametric form)'. Different because: r is unknown and determined by a distance-to-line condition.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, curve and symbol is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical brute-force check), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Stated that P is on the ray (not the whole line) and different from A, so the absolute value has one sign and the answer is unique. Changed: No change.
key_step: Writing P = (2 + 4r/5, 3 + 3r/5) and equating its distance from M to r.
justification: Routine use of the parametric form and the distance formula with a sign check; two standard steps. Comparable to routine L2 items such as 2026-P2-Q1.
